_doc: Per-file byte budgets for myos's always-on context stack: the files Claude Code loads every turn (CLAUDE.md natively, MYOS_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md via --append-system-prompt-file) plus the Algorithm, which every build run reads. BudgetCheck.ts fails when a file exceeds its budget: backpressure against re-accretion. Budgets are ceilings, not targets: to add, first prune. Raising a budget is a deliberate decision recorded in git, not a silent bump.
_convention: path is relative to ~/.myos (the myos install root) ; maxBytes is the hard ceiling. Files listed here that don't exist report MISSING and do not fail the check.
_addingFiles: Add a row whenever you make a file always-on (an @-import in CLAUDE.md, or a new --append-system-prompt-file target). Skills, workflows, MYOS/RULES and MYOS/DOCUMENTATION load on demand and are deliberately NOT budgeted.
_totalDoc: Hard ceiling on the SUM of the rows below (per-file caps alone never bound the whole stack). The three ceilings sum to 24KB; the other 6KB is reserved for the user owned MYOS/USER/PROJECTS.md index that CLAUDE.md imports (its 6KB ceiling is not a row here because every row must ship in the payload).

budgets.note: operational rules + routing table only; everything else loads on demand
constitutional; survives compaction, so every byte is paid for on every turn
